newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Petroz says to seek Hyland trial date.
newsitem.headline: Petroz says to seek Hyland trial date.

text.p: Oil and gas producer Petroz NL said on Monday it will seek a trial date for a dispute over part ownership of a Timor Gap exploration permit during a Federal Court review of the case in September.
Hyland Bay Pty Ltd has challenged Petroz's purchase of its 9.7 percent stake in Zone of Co-operation (ZOCA) permit 91-12 in January, 1994, shortly before the discovery of oil.
Hyland Bay has alleged Petroz withheld vital drilling information.

ZOCA 91-12 and the adjoining ZOCA 91-13 contain the Bayu-Undan discovery, which is estimated to have proven and probable reserves of 3.1 trillion cubic feet of gas and about 400 million barrels of liquids.
Petroz said in a statement the Federal Court would review the matter after the submission of final affidavits on September 11, and a trial date would be sought at this time.
It remained confident in its position and would continue to vigorously defend the action.
